messages:
elaine: incident-bot alerted unusual edge traffic to /v1/generate, large bursts from ASN 39876 and 39877. spikes ~2.5k rps, lots of same short connections. anyone else seeing this?
incidents-bot: Alert: ddos-signature-high - 1782345678 - severity: high - auto-rate-limit policy applied to /v1/generate (temp).
samir (ops-oncall): I see the spike. Many requests share same user-agent + repeated query patterns. WAF count increased. I'll bump per-ip caps and enable stricter burst controls.
nathan (sre-lead): suggest targeted WAF rule + blackhole routing if it escalates. Recommend blocking UA patterns and ASN-level drops for confirmed abusive origin.
elaine: applying WAF rule now. rule: block if user_agent =~ /curl|python-requests/ && requests_from_ip > 80/min. deploying via wafctl.
elaine: ```
# wafctl rule snippet
{
  "name": "block-suspcurl-1782345678",
  "match": {
    "user_agent": ".*(curl|python-requests).*",
    "request_rate_per_ip": ">80/min"
  },
  "action": "block"
}
```
ops-oncall: added nginx ingress annotations to enforce limit_req burst/zone for /v1/generate and set 429 on breach. config applied to eu-west and us-east.
ops-oncall: ```
nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/limit-rate: "200"
nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/limit-rps: "1000"
```
commops: any customer impact? monitoring shows transient errors for a small set of EU customers (5 customers) between t0+2m and t0+12m. drafting short notice.
nathan (sre-lead): enabled blackhole for ASN 39876 for 10m while we confirm. routed suspected traffic to scrub region (eu-scrub-1) for further analysis. fallback policy applied for Dedicated customers: failover to reserved capacity.
elaine: mitigation dropped attack volume to ~300 rps within 4 minutes, now ~150 rps. started capturing raw request dumps to s3://incidents/ddos/1782345678/ for forensics, objects encrypted. Need KMS key audit and access controls.
security-bot: New S3 object created: s3://incidents/ddos/1782345678/requests.pcap (kms:arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01)
samir (ops-oncall): confirming RBAC: only sec-incident-role and oncall roles can decrypt. I'll add a CloudTrail filter for GetRecords/GetObject on that prefix and extend retention to 1y.
commops: drafted customer message: "We observed anomalous traffic to the inference API and applied temporary rate limits. Some requests returned 429; this was a protective measure and we have since mitigated. Contact support if you see persistent issues." sending to legal for review. :eyes:
elaine: post-incident action items: 1) tune WAF fingerprint rules and add UA+payload signatures (owner: samir), 2) ASN auto-blacklist threshold & playbook (owner: nathan), 3) dashboard for per-customer error rates with alerting (owner: commops), 4) encryption/KMS audit run and key access review (owner: security), 5) tabletop exercise and update runbook to include blackhole thresholds (owner: elaine).
nathan (sre-lead): add runbook change: make blackhole timeout and thresholds configurable per-region and per-plan. Also add integration test in CI that simulates surge and validates wafctl rollout.
samir (ops-oncall): verifying S3 logs and CloudTrail entries now, will post verification in 30m. once done, we'll mark incident as mitigated and archive thread. :thumbsup:
elaine: thanks all. filing short incident summary for on-call rotation notes and scheduling 1-hour postmortem tomorrow. moving to archive when samir confirms logs. :white_check_mark:
